infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FortIRL shows the live camera behind the HUD, so zombies appear in the room with you.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FortIRL uses your position and heading to place you, your squad and the zombies in the building.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: FortIRL uses motion to follow where your blaster points and to count your steps.
